# DANZUS

> DANZUS Holdings LLC, in Folsom, California, builds websites and sets up local
> search and AI assistants for small businesses in Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville,
> El Dorado Hills, and nearby. A website starts at $1,500. SEO and AI search
> starts at $300 a month. A Google Business Profile and AI listing starter starts
> at $150 a month. Assistant packages are a flat monthly price. Owner: Dan Johnson.
> Call or text (916) 404-6129. Email dan@danzus.co.
> LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/danjohnsondata

## Service area

Sacramento, Folsom, Roseville, El Dorado Hills, and nearby.

## Services

- Website: a custom site for one local business, fast on a phone, built so the next step is a call or a lead. Starting at $1,500.
- SEO and AI search: Google Business Profile, local SEO, schema, an llms.txt file, and pages so the business can be described in Google and in AI answers such as ChatGPT and Perplexity. Starting at $300 a month.
- Google Business Profile and AI listing: a starter before the fuller search package. Starting at $150 a month.
- Lead to Booked Job: a new inquiry becomes a time on the calendar.
- Quote to Cash: an estimate becomes money in the account.
- Job Closeout: a finished job leaves a review and a referral.
- Back Office: the inbox, the bills, and the week land in one place.
- Customer Service: the customer gets an answer, a status, or a person.

The assistant uses the calendar, QuickBooks, a CRM, and the texting the shop already has. A person signs off on anything risky before it reaches a customer.

## Starting prices

These are starting ranges. The free call turns one into a fixed quote.

- Pilot: $150 a month, setup starting at $250. First three Sacramento-area shops, one package, in exchange for an honest testimonial.
- Starter: $200 to $300 a month, setup starting at $500. One package.
- Growth: $400 to $600 a month, setup starting at $1,000 to $1,500. Lead to Booked Job, Quote to Cash, and Job Closeout.
- Custom: $100 to $150 an hour, setup starting at $1,500. Back Office, live status, and connections into software the shop already runs.
- Website: starting at $1,500. A project, not a monthly assistant.
- SEO and AI search: starting at $300 a month.
- Google Business Profile and AI listing: starting at $150 a month.
